# Synthetic Scrapeyy v1 interoperability fixtures

These files were generated by the actual `encodeSession` function in
AaronCampbellit/Scrapeyy-public, portable-session-borrow feature, October 22,
2026. They contain only invented test data. The encrypted fixture's deliberately
public test PIN is `1234`. It must decrypt to `plaintext.json` unchanged.

They verify the extension-to-collector wire format independently of this
repository's own encryption fixture builder. They are not usable credentials.
